name: Double Recipe Test
description: Throwaway test mod. One column of flint, stick, and dry grass crafts either a copper ingot or a gold ingot. Flint in the quern grinds into either a copper ingot or a gold ingot. Sticks in a cooking pot cook into either one too. In a barrel with water, a stick turns into either ingot after sealing, and dry grass turns into either one at once.
